row.notes: (lib) Copy-assigns a vector of 4 byte elements (alignment 2, packed handles) into an optional vector whose engaged flag is at +0x20. When not engaged it copy-constructs (allocator, buffer of src capacity, element copy) and sets the flag; otherwise it does a normal copy assignment that reallocates only when src size exceeds dst capacity. Vectorised 32-element copy loops.
